Ignore blank lines and lines whose first non-whitespace character is #. Split each line at its first = only, so values may contain =. Strip surrounding whitespace from keys and values. Keys are case-sensitive. A later layer overrides an earlier layer's value for the same key. All other lines are valid; no broader grammar is required.

The complete requirement from the platform owner is supplied here: An assignment whose stripped value is empty deletes that key. It removes any earlier value instead of storing an empty string, and a later non-empty assignment can set the key again. No additional historical requirement is needed for this task.
